🎤 AMERICAN ACCENT CHALLENGE — Week 1: shadowing

How to shadow:
1️⃣ Watch the video 2–3 times.
2️⃣ Play a sentence, pause, and repeat it with the same rhythm, stress and melody.
3️⃣ Record yourself and send your video to me in a private chat with the bot by Saturday 12:00 GMT.

🗳️ Saturday 15:47 GMT: all entries appear anonymously and you vote for the best shadower.
🏆 Sunday 15:47 GMT: the winner is announced!
